messages:
Alex W: Heads-up — proposing a phase-based rolling update for inference-sts to smooth warmup spikes. Plan: set minReadySeconds=120, use StatefulSet partitioning for staged replacement, add a small preStart delay in the container to reduce concurrent CPU bursts. Terraform change in modules/k8s/statefulset.tf. PTAL?

Sara L: SGTM as a concept. Quick question: how does minReadySeconds=120 affect our HPA behavior? We have minReplicas=2 and scale-down might be delayed longer.

Chris P: Good call. We should tune the HPA stabilization window so scale-down isn't overly aggressive during rollout. Recommend stabilizationWindowSeconds=300 and set an annotation during rollout `redwood/scale-lock: "true"` that our autoscaler helper respects.

Maria G: One more note on secrets: the init container reads model key from `/opt/secrets/model-keys`. TF needs to expose `secrets.k8s_model_key_path` so rotation doesn't break mounts. I can change the module.

Alex W: Draft manifest snippet I'm planning to apply:
```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: inference-sts
spec:
  serviceName: inference
  replicas: 3
  updateStrategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      partition: 1
  minReadySeconds: 120
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: inference
        image: redwood/inference:stable
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: "1000m"
            memory: "4Gi"
        lifecycle:
          preStart:
            exec:
              command: ["/bin/sh", "-c", "sleep 20; /start-server"]
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /healthz?avg=true
            port: 8080
          initialDelaySeconds: 10
          periodSeconds: 15
```

Sara L: That preStart sleep looks reasonable. Requests look high — are we intentionally moving to guaranteed QoS? If so we should double-check memory requests to avoid OOMs.

Chris P: Note: StatefulSet `maxSurge` isn't supported like Deployments — partition is the right approach. We should add a canary annotation so infra can route a small percentage of traffic to new ordinals during the canary window.

Maria G: Terraform PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/789 — I added `staggered_rollout_enabled`, `k8s_model_key_path` var, and a `rollout_canary_window` default 600s. I also wired an annotation `redwood/rollout-phase` into the k8s module.

Alex W: @Sara L @Chris P can you quick-review that PR? Checklist: adjust CPU to 1000m, add `minReadySeconds`, set `redwood/rollout-phase: canary`, and ensure HPA sees `redwood/scale-lock: "true"` during rollout.

deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline queued for inference-sts — terraform plan OK, waiting for approvals.

Sara L: LGTM overall, left 2 small comments about var naming and docstrings.

Chris P: Approved. Suggest adding a canary healthcheck: require `avg_latency < 200ms` over the canary window. If that fails, automated partition rollback of 2 ordinals.

Alex W: Will add `canary_health_thresholds` var and default canary window to 10 minutes. Health probe will use `/healthz?avg=true`. Also adding a small `kubectl` command in the runbook: `kubectl rollout status sts/inference-sts -w --timeout=15m` and `kubectl get pods -l app=inference -o wide` for verification.

Maria G: I'll sequence the secret rotation so new pods mount the rotated secret at `secrets.k8s_model_key_path`. No downtime planned. I'll add a note in the PR about migration steps.

Alex W: Thanks all. I'll merge when CI passes. If anything spikes we can flip `redwood/rollout-phase` to `stable` and set the partition back to previous ordinal to rollback. :eyes:

Sara L: :thumbsup:

Chris P: :shipit:
